# Changelog

Only when the source has a changelog, release notes or "What's new" section.

## Shape

If the source keeps each entry at its own URL, consolidate into one page of `<Update>` blocks, newest first. Do not create one `.mdx` per entry. If the source already has a single changelog page, convert it in place.

```mdx
---
title: 'Changelog'
rss: true
---

<Update
  label="September 8, 2025"
  description="New endpoints for company locations"
  tags={['Added', 'API']}
>
  Entry body, converted like any other page.
</Update>
```

- `title` and `description` on the page follow the normal frontmatter rules.
- `label` is the date, `description` is the entry title, `tags` are the entry's type and categories as shown on the source. Do not invent tags.
- Every `label` must be unique on the page. When two entries share a date, add the time to both (`September 8, 2025 · 4:28 PM`); if no time is available, ask the user. Never put slugs or IDs in labels.
- Record each entry's source URL in the manifest.

Reference: https://www.mintlify.com/docs/create/changelogs.md

Past about 15 entries, generate the page with a script from the mirrored entries, and make sure the main transformer does not also emit per-entry pages.

## Dates

Use the publish date shown on, or embedded in, each entry page. Never use sitemap `<lastmod>`: hosted platforms rewrite it on every re-index, so it clusters many entries into a few recent dates. If no publish date is available, ask the user and report it.

Sanity check: the oldest and newest labels match the oldest and newest entries on the source. If more than about a third of entries share one week, you have re-index dates; go back and find real ones.

## URLs

Add a redirect from every per-entry URL to the consolidated page (with an anchor if you can match it):

```json
{ "source": "/changelog/new-company-location-endpoints", "destination": "/changelog" }
```

Point in-repo links at the consolidated page directly. The source's changelog listing page has no separate counterpart; mark it `done` against the consolidated page.
